'''Riss Clyos''' was a [[Rebel pilot]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance's]] [[Green Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Green Squadron]] who flew as [[Green Three]].<ref name="Rogue One Visual Guide" /> They most notably fought in the [[Battle of Scarif]].<ref name="Rogue One">''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:RissClyosHelmet-SW100Objects.png|thumb|right|200px|Riss Clyos's flight helmet]]
Riss Clyos first appeared through their [[X-wing starfighter]] in ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''.<ref name="Rogue One" /> They were then identified in ''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]'' where their helmet was pictured but not Clyos.<ref name="Rogue One Visual Guide" />
